### `POST` `/subscriptions`

Asks for pet events, sent to the URL in the body, and pings, sent to the URL in X-Callback.

- Operation ID: `subscribe`

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `X-Callback` | header | string (uri) | no |  |

**Request body** (required)

- `application/json`: object

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | string (uri) | yes |  |

**Responses**

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `201` | Subscribed. |
| `default` | Refused. |

`201`:

- `application/json`: object

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes |  |

Headers:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Location` | string | no |  |

**Callbacks**

**`status`: `POST` `{$request.body#/url}/subscriptions/{$response.body#/id}?status={$statusCode}`**

- Sent by the API

**Responses**

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `204` | Received. |

**`moved`: `POST` `{$url}/moved?to={$response.header.Location}`**

- Sent by the API

**Responses**

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `204` | Received. |

**`petEvent`: `POST` `{$request.body#/url}/pets/{$method}`**

- Sent by the API

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `X-Event` | header | string | yes | enum: `"created"`, `"deleted"` |

**Request body** (required)

- `application/json`: [Pet](#pet)

**Responses**

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `204` | Received. |
| `410` | Unsubscribed. |

**`ping`: `GET` `{$request.header.X-Callback}`**

- Sent by the API
- Security: [hookToken](#hooktoken) or none

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `n` | query | integer | no | minimum: `1` |

**Responses**

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `200` | Pong. |

`200`:

- `text/plain`: string

## Webhooks

### `POST` webhook `petAdopted`

- Security: [hookKey](#hookkey) or [basicAuth](#basicauth)

**Request body** (required)

- `application/json`: object

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pet` | [Pet](#pet) | yes |  |
| `by` | string | yes | minLength: `1` |
| `confirmUrl` | string (uri) | no |  |

**Responses**

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `200` | Acknowledged. |

`200`:

- `application/json`: object

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ok` | boolean | no |  |

**Callbacks**

**`confirm`: `POST` `{$request.body#/confirmUrl}`**

The consumer confirms the adoption back to the API.

- Sent back to the API by the receiver of the operation declaring it
- Operation ID: `confirmAdoption`
- Security: [apiKey](#apikey)

**Request body** (required)

- `application/json`: object

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `receiptUrl` | string (uri) | yes |  |
| `note` | string | no |  |

**Responses**

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `204` | Confirmed. |

**Callbacks**

**`receipt`: `POST` `{$request.body#/receiptUrl}`**

The API sends the consumer a receipt.

- Sent by the API
- Operation ID: `sendReceipt`
- Security: [hookToken](#hooktoken)

**Request body** (required)

- `text/plain`: string

**Responses**

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `204` | Received. |

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `photo` | string (binary) | yes |  |

| `meta.width` | integer | no |  |

- `image/png`: string (binary)

**Responses**

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `200` | Stored. |

`200`:

- `application/json`: object

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | integer | no |  |

Headers:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `X-Stored` | integer | yes |  |
